lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: FINE! It was me! [beat] I took the paper! [beat] But you don't know WHY!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Bro… [beat] you're the LOYAL one. [beat] That's your whole thing!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Three weeks ago I heard the board's plan. [beat] Fail HALF the class. [beat] Re-exam fees — charged TWICE.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: A conspiracy ABOVE the principal?! [beat] I've told six versions of this story [beat] and ALL of them were too small!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: No paper… no mass fail. [beat] No fail… no fees. [beat] I didn't steal answers. [beat] I stole the WEAPON.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Silence. [beat] The kind where a whole school realizes… [beat] the thief was protecting them.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: That plan was NEVER mine. [beat] The board proposed it. [beat] And tonight — the board answers to ME.

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Then explain the impossible. [beat] The tag on that spare key… [beat] is written in MY handwriting. [beat] I never wrote it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The twist inside the twist. [beat] Kamal heard the plan too. [beat] He couldn't be seen helping… [beat] so he left the key where a loyal kid would find it.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: New exam. Written in the open. [beat] And Joy — [beat] your detention starts AFTER the fair exam.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow for the next story! [beat] If a KEY can hide a hero… [beat] imagine what a report card hides.
